plays.name: 41 FLOW — Core
plays.description: Rehecho: Rebound/Outlet → 5 Drag → Second Side → Zoom/Chicago → re-PnR → Flow Loop, con timing y handoff corregidos.

plays.name: 41 FLOW — Pistol 21 Chase
plays.description: Advance → Chase/Get → 4 Trail Side PnR → Second Side con 5 → regreso a Flow. Incluye lectura KEEP.

plays.name: 4-Out 1-In — Pistol Split Flow
plays.description: Entrada 4-Out 1-In con corte al aro, pin-down simultáneo, reversa y PnR con opciones al roll y al corner 3.

plays.name: 4-Out 1-In — Pistol → Zoom → PnR
plays.description: Flow continuo: entrada Pistol, Zoom con pin-down + handoff y re-screen inmediato de 5 para PnR con opciones al roll y al corner.

plays.name: Double Screen Spanish — Virtus
plays.description: VIRTUS OFFENSE pág. 17: double screen y continuación de pases 1→5→2→4, reconstruido desde los dos diagramas originales.

plays.name: RAM SPAIN 45 — Non-Shooting 4/5
plays.description: Barcelona-inspired RAM → Spain adapted for two non-shooting bigs: 4 RAM/dunker, 5 screen-roll, 2 backscreen-pop, plus automatic second-side continuation.

plays.name: PRINCETON CHIN — Motion Continuity
plays.description: Corregido según los 4 diagramas originales: guard-to-guard → wing entry/Chin cut → follow screen/back cut → fill/reverse y repetir.

plays.name: GT FLOW — CORE: Drag → Zoom → Re-PnR
plays.description: Corrección profesional: llegada → 4 Trail Drag → reverse → pin-down → Zoom/DHO → 5 Re-PnR → reset. Screens separados en SET→USE→RELEASE y 4/5 no hacen pop.

plays.name: GT FLOW — Pistol/Get → Trail PnR
plays.description: Corrección profesional: Advance → Get/Keep → 4 Trail PnR → 5 Second Side. Handoff y ball screens con APPROACH→SET→USE→RELEASE.

plays.name: GT FLOW — Double Drag → Hub DHO
plays.description: Corrección profesional: 5 primer Drag, 4 segundo Drag, 5 roll tras primer uso, 4 short-roll hub, DHO y re-screen. Sin screen/roll simultáneo.

plays.name: GT FLOW — Secondary Flare
plays.description: Corrección profesional de Serbia Secondary Flare: 1→4→3, 2 fade; screens se establecen antes de PnR + flare; 4 rola después del uso.

plays.name: GT FLOW — Early DHO → Side PnR
plays.description: Corrección profesional: pass-to-trail → approach → DHO → 5 Side PnR → second side. Transferencia y screens respetan dependencias.

plays.name: GT FLOW — Continuity Reset
plays.description: Corrección profesional: Wing PnR → top → dribble-at/backdoor read → opposite PnR. El backdoor es opción y no altera la continuidad base.

plays.name: IISALO FLOW — Angle → Empty → Third Side
plays.description: Iisalo Flow: 1–5 Angle P&R → reverse → 4 throw-and-chase / 2–4 Empty P&R → reverse → 1–5 Third-Side Top P&R.

plays.name: TEST — Motion 4-1 Timing
plays.description: Prueba de timing: pass/cut/fill → pin-down → Get/DHO → side PnR. 'Misma vez' solo en reacciones que comparten trigger.

plays.name: TEST — Handoff Middle
plays.description: Approach → contacto/transferencia → salida continua hacia middle; el receptor no regresa.

plays.name: TEST — Handoff Baseline
plays.description: Approach diagonal → handoff → salida continua hacia baseline sin devolverse.

plays.name: TEST — Handoff + Re-screen
plays.description: Approach → handoff → salida continua → re-screen → use → roll.
